title: Stack Profile v1
description: Frontmatter of a stack profile: .planning/STACK.md, a component profile under .planning/stacks/, an org/pack profile at ~/.claude/aoforge/stacks/<id>.md, or the bundled references/stack-general.md. See docs/PROPOSAL-stack-profile.md. Only structure is declared here. Cross-field rules (loop/gates reference defined command keys, `extends` resolves, no cycles, `regenerate` names a command) are checked in code by `aof-tools stack validate`, not in this schema, so each rule has one home. The markdown body's fixed H2 sections are also validated in code.

commandKey.description: Standard keys agents know by name. Projects may add their own keys matching the pattern; loop/gates can reference either.

run.description: Full-scope invocation. `discover` = find it per general Principle 1; `none` = this project has no such step.

scoped.description: Narrow form for the inner loop. Placeholders: {files}, {packages}.

apply.description: Mutating form, for format/fix commands whose `run` only checks or previews.

when.description: Only run when this condition holds; otherwise the step is skipped, not failed.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to the profile's component root.

version_source.description: File the version is read from (go.mod, pubspec.yaml, package.json, .tool-versions, …). Preferred over restating a version.

extends.description: Parent profile id, or null for the root (`general` only). Omitted means `general`.

detect.description: Org/pack profiles only: markers that suggest this profile when drafting a STACK.md. A string names a root entry (e.g. go.mod, or *.ext for any entry with that suffix). An object {file, contains} names a root file that must also include the text `contains` (e.g. {file: pubspec.yaml, contains: "sdk: flutter"}).

markers.description: Regexes matched against a file's first 5 lines.

agent_tooling.description: References to upstream agent artifacts. AOForge never vendors their content into core.

required.description: true: verify reports `missing` if absent. false: agents fall back to the CLI commands.

source.description: Repo or package providing agentskills.io SKILL.md files.

instructions.description: Model instructions a tool publishes (e.g. `gopls mcp -instructions`). Fetched at setup, cached, not inlined here.

telemetry.description: Quote the value in YAML: a bare `off` parses as boolean false.

network_tools.description: Whether tools that call hosted services (registry search, hosted doc MCPs) may be enabled.

runtime_check.description: Command key the verifier runs to exercise the built artifact (smoke run, e2e).

profile.description: Path to a component profile (same schema), or an org/pack profile id.
